canonical_name: Pythagorean theorem for a right Euclidean triangle (exact encoding and boundary policy open)
category: 几何学 / 欧几里得几何
literal_source_claim_zh: 直角三角形两直角边平方和等于斜边平方
literal_source_claim_en: In a right triangle, the sum of the squares of the two legs equals the square of the hypotenuse.
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For three points in a source-selected real Euclidean affine space, if the source-selected angle is right, then the square of the opposite side length equals the sum of the squares of the adjacent side lengths.
